answer_1.quote: Evaluated on an 11-task benchmark, ITT consistently outperforms Transformer and Loop variants with an equivalent parameters.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates on language modeling, reasoning, and instruction-following tasks, which involve natural language generation as part of the model's core functionality, particularly in open-ended and multi-step reasoning settings.

answer_2.quote: We employed the lm-evaluation-harness to evaluate our models. For common sense and reading comprehension tasks, we report 0-shot accuracy for SciQ, PIQA, WinoGrande (WG), ARC Easy(ARC-E), and 10-shot HellaSwag (Hella.), alongside 25-shot accuracy for ARC Challenge (ARC-C). For continued QA and text understanding, we report 0-shot accuracy for LogiQA, 32-shot BoolQ, and 0-shot LAMBADA (Lam.).
